title: Auditor Assurance Pack: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Restarts and spares purchases can both be tested from existing records.

sections.heading: Why existing assurance did not catch it

items.text: The findings record no check of purchase records against specifications [FND-0003; EVD-0003].

items.requirement: Every restart after pressure-boundary work has a leak-test record
items.conformity_evidence: A signed test record on each work order
red_flags: Work order closed with no test entry

items.requirement: Critical spares are bought to a specification
items.conformity_evidence: A specification reference on each order
red_flags: Local purchase with no technical approval

items.requirement: Seal changes are planned with a written test step
items.conformity_evidence: A test step in each job plan
red_flags: Job plan with no test step

items.requirement: Test equipment for leak tests is available and in date
The procedure index covers return to service
items.conformity_evidence: An entry for return to service
red_flags: No entry, or a draft only

items.requirement: Procedures are reviewed after equipment changes
items.sample: Procedure review log since the last equipment change
items.conformity_evidence: A review date after each change

items.requirement: Substitute parts go through change control
Stores checks the specification at issue
Local purchases of critical spares are reported
red_flags: Local purchases missing from the report

items.requirement: Gas alarms are classed by the action they need
items.sample: The alarm list for the area
items.conformity_evidence: An action class for each gas alarm
red_flags: Display-only gas alarms with no action set

items.requirement: Alarm changes are approved by the technical authority
Management review covers spares and testing indicators

items.text: Return-to-service procedure and its revision history
Grade each test point: conforming, partly, not, or not tested.
